entities.summary: The Perm Regional Museum, also known as the Perm Museum of Local Lore, is a museum located in Perm, Perm Krai, Russia. The museum maintains a number of permanent and temporary exhibitions and is a tourist attraction. Perm Regional Museum is a museum in Europe, established in 1890.
